pages.title: Chrono Loom
pages.text: Weaves worldlines. Reverses the arrow of time, ties temporal knots and enforces self-consistency on time loops.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)worldline$() is the path an object traces through spacetime - every moment of its existence strung together like thread. The loom handles them exactly that way. What it weaves is in my notes on temporal mechanics.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Arrow of Time Shard, Christoffel Symbol, Chronon Gas, Geodesic Thread, Novikov Crystal, Stress-Energy Tensor, Temporal Knot.
